A '''Imperial Safe House''' was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was used by [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:FtE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I'll have the pilot sent to a safe house where you will pick him up.|[[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]]|<ref name="SWG:FtE" />}}
The Imperial Safe House was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial Safe House was added to the game with the fourth chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

In the fourth quest of the "Secrets of the Syren" arc, the player had to choose to work with either [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] Officer [[Wolff Kalos]] or Imperial Officer M'Kae. This article assumes that the player was affiliated the Rebel Alliance. During the hunt for [[Cal Handro]] and the [[Syren spice]] on Rori, Rebel players had to fight Imperial [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] in a [[Rebel Safe House]] to prevent Cal Handro to escape.<ref name="SWG:FtA">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "For the Alliance!"</ref> If the player chose the Empire, he/she would have to fight Rebel mercenaries in the Imperial Safe House instead.<ref name="SWG:FtE" />
